name: verilog-builder-icarus
description: Builds Verilog designs with Icarus Verilog module-by-module, streams live progress, runs simulations, and supports prompt-driven fixes.

interface.shortDescription: Write, build, debug, and simulate Verilog with Icarus Verilog.
interface.longDescription: An open-source Verilog workflow built on Icarus Verilog: describe a module in English and have it written for you, build the design module-by-module with live progress, investigate and fix compile errors mid-build, and run simulations that produce VCD waveforms. No FPGA vendor tooling required.
defaultPrompt: Create a new Icarus Verilog project for a design I describe.
Build my Icarus Verilog project and show live progress.
Simulate my design with Icarus Verilog and show the output.
